title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: In gradient descent, we update the parameters in the direction that reduces the loss. Think about how the loss function $L(\theta)=y_i-f_{\theta}(x_i)$ behaves as $\theta_0$ changes. What happens to the residuals when $\theta_0$ increases?

title: Exploring the Loss Function
text: Consider the role of $\theta_0$ in the model $f_{\theta}(x)=\theta_0*0.5+\theta_0*\theta_1*x_1+\sin(\theta_1)*x_2$. How does increasing $\theta_0$ affect the output of the model?

title: Predicting the Behavior of $\theta_0$
text: As $t$ grows large, what is the most likely behavior of $\theta_0**{(t)}$ in terms of its value?
choices: $\theta_0**{(t)}$ converges to a finite positive value
